_source: made by hand from ff2_real_ground.json (same keys, same change points) for tests/fixtures/ff2_marked.csv, Hong's 12 November walk map (data/route/2026-11-12T152109Z/map.csv, byte copy): each polyline is extended at an end to the x of that map's end-mark node there, flat at the polyline's end y, where the node lies beyond it: mid-left from x 44 to 32 (left mark (32, 46)), mid-right from x 94 to 88 (left mark (88, 43)) and from 122 to 129 (right mark (129, 43)), top from x 113 to 124 (right mark (124, 23); the top's end y is 24); the floor is unchanged (30-135).
